title: Luciano Benetton, el pionero de la moda que convirtió la publicidad en provocación y el color en un imperio que se está desvaneciendo

en: Luciano Benetton, the fashion pioneer who turned advertising into provocation and color into a fading empire. He rose from poverty in Italy to become a multimillionaire with a global fashion brand and some of the most controversial advertising campaigns in history.
